# Anamorphic streaks

Stretches bright lights into long horizontal lines, the blue flares of anamorphic cinema lenses.

<EffectDemo effect="anamorphic" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { anamorphic } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/anamorphic';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(anamorphic({ preset: 'cinema' }));
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.intensity = 1`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter   | Type                                                      | Default        | Range | Description                                  |
| ----------- | --------------------------------------------------------- | -------------- | ----- | -------------------------------------------- |
| `intensity` | number                                                    | `1`            | 0 – 4 | Brightness of the streaks.                   |
| `threshold` | number                                                    | `1`            | 0 – 8 | Linear brightness above which lights streak. |
| `length`    | number                                                    | `0.6`          | 0 – 1 | Length of the streaks.                       |
| `tint`      | hex color (theme: [`accent`](/guide/holocss#theme-roles)) | `'#6fa8ff'`    |       | Color of the streaks.                        |
| `direction` | 'horizontal' \| 'vertical'                                | `'horizontal'` |       | Orientation of the streaks.                  |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset     | Settings                               |
| ---------- | -------------------------------------- |
| `cinema`   | `intensity: 1.4`, `length: 0.8`        |
| `warm`     | `tint: '#ffb36b'`                      |
| `subtle`   | `intensity: 0.5`, `length: 0.4`        |
| `vertical` | `direction: 'vertical'`, `length: 0.5` |

Apply one with `anamorphic({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Lens & camera · tracked as story X4.7 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** samples the pass input at other positions, so it starts a new merged pass; following pixel effects join that pass. It also renders its own intermediate passes before the merged pass.
- **Masks:** set `effect.mask` to a texture, depth range or selection to limit where it applies; see [masks](/guide/masks).
- **Motion:** Static: nothing animates.
- **Cost:** 69.9 ms added to a 960×540 frame on CI container (SwiftShader software renderer) (2026-10-11). A software renderer: use it to compare effects, not to predict GPU times.
- **Size:** 6.5 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/anamorphic`, including the shared effect runtime.
